# Raul S Freitas Landscapes (RSFL)

> Skip hire, landscaping, block paving and slab laying in Jersey, Channel Islands.

## Contact

- Email: raul@rsfl.je

## Services

- Skip hire in Jersey: skip delivery, collection and waste removal for garden, home and building projects.
- Landscaping: new gardens and garden makeovers, hard and soft landscaping.
- Block paving: driveways, paths and parking areas.
- Patios and slab laying: patios, paths and terraces with paving slabs.
- Fencing, garden walls and other outdoor work.
